conditions.measurement_path: offline f64 synthetic signal -> Rust processor modules -> numeric analysis
conditions.thdn_method: least-squares sine fit with DC term, THD+N = residual_rms / fitted_sine_rms
conditions.frequency_response_method: single-tone amplitude fit after 44.1 kHz -> 48 kHz resampling
conditions.stopband_method: 96 kHz -> 48 kHz resampling of above-output-Nyquist tones; alias fit plus broad residual RMS
conditions.saturation_continuity_method: one-sided finite-difference transfer probe across the soft-knee threshold for Tape/Tube/Transistor with non-unity output gain
conditions.saturation_aliasing_method: 11 kHz driven tube waveshaper; fit folded above-Nyquist harmonics and compare source-rate Direct vs Oversampled4x alias energy
conditions.listening_dsp_method: single-tone fits through IIR EQ, libbs2b-style low-pass/high-boost Bauer crossfeed, and dynamic-loudness processors after settling; crossfeed also checks the independent 4.5 dB reference DC profile and parameter-ramp continuity
conditions.limiter_method: PeakLimiter (default 4x-oversampled true-peak detection) in-place processing; reports sample-peak ceiling, below-threshold THD+N, and intersample-peak stress vs legacy sample-peak mode
conditions.noise_shaping_method: 16-bit NoiseShaper error signal FFT with Hann window; equal-width 2-6/6-10/14-18 kHz RMS bands plus -140 dBFS, silence, overload, and non-finite boundary probes
conditions.loudness_reference_method: LoudnessMeter wrapper compared with direct ebur128 over deterministic f64 fixtures; optional EBU Tech 3341/3342 corpus expected-value checks
conditions.full_output_true_peak_method: offline render stages: Volume,Equalizer,Saturation,Crossfeed,Convolver,DynamicLoudness,Resampler,PeakLimiter,NoiseShaper,Quantize; post-render analysis: LoudnessMeterTruePeak
